name.en: Short-time32body dynamics from a cold Plummer-density sample

caption.en: Validation figure from actual saved fixed-input calculation arrays.

formula: \boldsymbol a_i=-G\sum_{j\ne i}m_j\frac{\boldsymbol x_i-\boldsymbol x_j}{(|\boldsymbol x_i-\boldsymbol x_j|^2+\epsilon^2)^{3/2}}

note.ja: 孤立系のPlummer軟化力と、周期・平均密度除去のPoisson式は異なる境界問題です。公開例は静的な力と境界核の検証で、自己重力流体の時間発展ではありません。
note.en: Isolated Plummer-softened forces and periodic mean-subtracted Poisson are distinct boundary problems. Public examples check static forces and kernels, not coupled self-gravitating flow evolution.

equation_note.ja: 固定32等質量・切断r3の密度由来反対称座標、初速0、epsilon.05、T.2。密度尺度a1とは別。
equation_note.en: Fixed32equal masses,antipodal truncatedr3 density-derived positions,zero velocity,epsilon.05,T.2; density scalea1 differs from pair softening.

note.en: Separate time and tree-force errors for the same softened finite-N ODE with independent DOP853/direct-force references and budgets.

title.ja: 冷たいPlummer密度由来32粒子の短時間力学
title.en: Short-time32body dynamics from a cold Plummer-density sample

assumptions.ja: 固定32等質量・切断r3の密度由来反対称座標、初速0、epsilon.05、T.2。密度尺度a1とは別。 非零の固定尺度、同一座標上の力、同期E/P/L/COM、theta0対照、非対称静的probe。 冷たい有限N初期値で平衡Plummer分布/連続球厳密軌道ではありません。BHの一般相反性・大域symplectic性は主張しません。
assumptions.en: Fixed32equal masses,antipodal truncatedr3 density-derived positions,zero velocity,epsilon.05,T.2; density scalea1 differs from pair softening.

note.ja: 冷たい有限N初期値で平衡Plummer分布/連続球厳密軌道ではありません。BHの一般相反性・大域symplectic性は主張しません。
note.en: Cold finite-N initial value,not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum orbit. No general BH reciprocity/global symplecticity claim.

reference_note.ja: 非零の固定尺度、同一座標上の力、同期E/P/L/COM、theta0対照、非対称静的probe。
reference_note.en: Nonzero fixed scales,same-position force comparison,synchronizedE/P/L/COM,theta0 control and asymmetric static probe.

method_note.ja: 直接KDK20/40/80steps、最細でtheta0/.35/.6のfull second-moment BH。独立scalar対力+DOP853を2許容値で資格確認。
method_note.en: Direct KDK20/40/80steps; finest-dt full second-moment BHtheta0/.35/.6; qualify independent scalar-pair DOP853 at two tolerances.
